english: "Not" — used to negate verbs and adjectives. Ada apel? (Do you) have an apple? Tidak ada. (No, I) don't have. Apel baik? (Is it a) good apple? Tidak baik. (No, it's) not good.
"No" — used to negate nouns. Ini apel? Is this an apple? Bukan. Ini jeruk. No, it's an orange.
"Not yet" — used when something has not happened (yet). Sudah makan apel? Have you already eaten the apple? Belum. No, not yet.
"Don't" — to tell somebody not to do something. Jangan makan apel! Don't eat the apple!
"Forbidden" — used mostly on signs. Dilarang makan apel. Eating apple is forbidden.
